visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A fair-skinned male with black hair wearing a black t-shirt stands against a clean, bright white studio background. He holds two rectangular silver makeup palettes toward the camera, smiling with high energy. The palettes are open, revealing gradient blushes in warm and cool tones. Large variety-style text overlays appear at the bottom. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of the male's hands holding the open palettes. One palette shows a gradient from yellow to coral-pink, and the other shows a gradient from purple to magenta. Text labels '#112' and '#113' are superimposed over the blushes. He moves the palettes slightly to catch the studio light. (3) The man brings the palettes closer to his face, one on each side, squinting his eyes and smiling widely. He gestures toward the palettes as he speaks, appearing excited. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the blushes. (4) The video transitions to a close-up of his arm, showing swatches of the warm-toned blush. He then uses a black makeup brush to apply the blush from palette #112 to his right cheek. He looks into a mirror off-camera, his expression focused and enthusiastic. Graphics and text overlays emphasize his movements. (5) He holds palette #113, which has a distinct purple-to-pink gradient. He points to it and then to his face. A cartoon graphic of Elsa from 'Frozen' appears briefly in the corner for comparison. He begins applying the cool-toned purple blush to his left cheek using a smaller brush, blending it carefully under his eye. (6) He shows both sides of his face to the camera, comparing the warm-toned right cheek and the cool-toned left cheek. He holds both palettes up again, gesturing with a 'V' sign. The video ends with him smiling and inviting viewers to try the products, with final promotional text appearing on screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male voice introduces two blush colors with a fast speech rate and bright pitch. An upbeat, syncopated electronic BGM with a steady kick drum begins. A soft 'pop' SFX accompanies the initial text appearing on screen. (2) The voice peaks in arousal while describing the colors as 'special'. A 'ding' SFX sounds as product numbers appear. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (3) Professional yet enthusiastic narration details the application process. A subtle 'whoosh' SFX is used during quick visual transitions. Vocal clarity is high. (4) As the creator introduces the 'weird' purple color, his tone becomes more comedic and inquisitive. A sparkling sound effect plays when the cartoon Elsa graphic appears. (5) The audio layers become more complex with several 'ding' and 'pop' SFX highlighting variety-show captions. The speaker's voice is energetic and persuasive, maintaining a high volume and fast tempo. (6) Final concluding phrases delivered with high authority and friendly tone. BGM swells slightly for the outro before a clean hard cut at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To review and demonstrate the application of two new SUQQU blush palettes, specifically addressing their unique color gradients and showing how they look on different skin tones to encourage purchase.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator focuses entirely on demonstrating and reviewing SUQQU blushes, mentioning the brand name and product codes repeatedly in both speech and text.
